raw_artifacts.exact_artifact: Operational generator fueling requirements lesson page

coverage.summary: FEMA full-load diesel-generator fuel rule of thumb by rated generator kilowatts.

fields.source_location: FEMA formula term kW size of the generator
FEMA rule of thumb 0.07 gallons/hour times generator kW

supported_uses: Estimate full-load diesel-generator fuel use per operating hour from rated generator kilowatts
Calculate annual routine-test diesel fuel per equipment unit when annual full-load test hours are separately documented
unsupported_inferences: Natural-gas, propane, battery, fuel-cell, or hybrid backup-system fuel use
Standby electrical input or annual standby electricity
provenance_notes: The source calls the coefficient a rule of thumb and limits it to diesel generators.
RetroFi applies the coefficient only to a documented full-load diesel test and does not treat it as a manufacturer-specific curve.
